body.rationale: Probe the top rung of block 0 first: a verified witness at rung 4 would settle all five lower rungs in that block by monotone closure. With no evidence yet, a bounded local search is the cheapest high-upside first move before committing exact budget.

Block 0 still has no evidence: the failed top-rung local search only says the hardest rung did not quickly yield a witness. The middle rung is the best pivot because a verified witness would close rungs 0-2 as SATISFIABLE, while a completed refutation would close rungs 2-4 as UNSATISFIABLE within block 0. Use symmetry mode to improve the chance of a decisive exact result under the shared budget.

The completed refutation at rung 2 settles rungs 2, 3, and 4 in block 0 by monotone closure. Blocks are independent, so the best next step is to probe the analogous middle rung in an untouched block; a refutation at rung 7 would settle three more rungs in block 1, while a witness would at least settle rungs 5 through 7 as satisfiable.

Use exact solving at the middle rung of an untouched independent block. A refutation there would settle rungs 12-14 by monotone closure; a witness would settle rungs 10-12. Prior exact symmetry solves at comparable middle rungs were decisive and well within this node budget.

The only block with no evidence is block 3, so the next highest-value action is an exact solve near its middle. Rung 17 can settle three rungs either way: a witness would close rungs 15-17 as SATISFIABLE, while a refutation would close rungs 17-19 as UNSATISFIABLE.

Use exact solving on the highest currently unresolved lower rung in block 0. Because rung 1 is below the completed refutation at rung 2, a witness would settle rungs 0 and 1 as SATISFIABLE by downward monotonicity, while a refutation would at least settle rung 1 and preserve the existing upward UNSAT closure. Symmetry was effective on prior exact solves, and 59000 keeps the shared budget viable for two more similar probes.

Block 0 is now fully bracketed by the verified witness at rung 1 and the completed refutation at rung 2, so rungs 0-4 can be claimed. The highest-value next probe is rung 6 in block 1: it is immediately below the existing refutation at rung 7, so either a witness settles rungs 5-6 as satisfiable or a completed refutation settles rung 6 as unsatisfiable as well. This spends a controlled amount of the remaining budget while targeting an unresolved boundary within an already-partially-solved block.

Final call: emit all warranted claims using only within-block monotone closure. No cross-block inference is applied. Rungs 10, 11, 18, and 19 remain unresolved because there is no witness/refutation that propagates to them.

Final call: only verdicts licensed by verified witnesses, completed refutations, or within-block monotone closure are asserted. All remaining rungs without such licences are left unresolved.
